blurb: Apple provides a comprehensive password management ecosystem built into iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and Safari. Automatic Strong Passwords generates cryptographically random credentials stored in iCloud Keychain, synced end-to-end encrypted across devices. Password AutoFill securely retrieves credentials via associated domains verification. Password Monitoring checks stored passwords against known breach databases using a private set intersection protocol with NIST P-256 elliptic curve encryption, so Apple never learns which specific passwords a user has while still detecting compromised credentials. Sign in with Apple provides privacy-preserving OAuth authentication with an optional email relay service.
